title: Approval to extend property tax break for Bronx HDFC housing
summary: This resolution approves a real property tax exemption for an affordable housing project at Block 3304, Lot 156 and Block 3324, Lot 99 in the Bronx, operated by Mosholu Concourse Housing Development Fund Corporation. The exemption runs through 40 years from June 25, 2021 or until the regulatory agreement ends, and depends on continued compliance with that agreement and with Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law.
